tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in the Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d) position at Workwise GmbH. With over five years of professional backend and e-commerce platform engineering experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a strong technical understanding of web systems and digital platforms.

bullets.label: Agile & Collaboration
bullets.text: I bring solid experience working within agile and Scrum environments, collaborating closely with international technical teams and stakeholders.

bullets.label: Platform & Data Delivery
bullets.text: My background includes designing backend functionality, managing product catalog flows, and working extensively with large enterprise e-commerce systems.

bullets.label: Analytical & Problem Solving
bullets.text: I have a proven record of investigating integration bottlenecks, executing database query refactoring to improve transaction speed, and supporting production troubleshooting.

bullets.label: Technical Foundation
bullets.text: Built on a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering/IT, my technical background allows me to bridge complex business requirements and development workflows effectively.

cover_en.gap: While my career is rooted in software engineering and e-commerce backend development rather than dedicated Product Ownership, I am keen to learn and transition my strong technical background, analytical mindset, and stakeholder collaboration experience into this domain.
cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period until 15 December 2026, with my earliest start date on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support your e-commerce initiatives.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für die Position als Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d) bei Workwise GmbH gelesen. Mit über fünf Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Software- und E-Commerce-Entwicklung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte technische Kenntnisse digitaler Plattformen mit.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Ich habe umfassende praktische Erfahrung in agilen Teams (Scrum), der Arbeit mit Jira und Confluence sowie der engen Abstimmung mit internationalen Stakeholdern.

bullets.label: Plattform- und Datenarchitektur
bullets.text: Bei meiner Arbeit an großen E-Commerce-Plattformen habe ich Backend-Funktionalitäten entworfen, Datenströme optimiert und Produktdaten-Pipelines betreut.

bullets.label: Analytische Vorgehensweise
bullets.text: Zu meinen Stärken gehören strukturierte Problemlösungen, die Analyse von Systemengpässen sowie die Optimierung von Datenabfragen und Transaktionsgeschwindigkeiten.

bullets.label: Ausbildung
bullets.text: Mein fundiertes technisches Fundament basiert auf einem Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering / IT.

cover_de.gap: Da mein Schwerpunkt bisher auf der technischen Software- und E-Commerce-Entwicklung liegt, bringe ich keine direkte Berufserfahrung als Product Owner mit, bin jedoch hoch motiviert, diesen Bereich zu lernen und meine Fähigkeiten einzubringen.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag im aktuellen Beschäftigungsverhältnis ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join Workwise GmbH because of your prominent role in digital platforms and hosting services, and the opportunity to work in a hybrid environment with modern office spaces in Karlsruhe. Your commitment to employee development and agile cross-functional collaboration aligns well with my professional background.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated to apply my 5+ years of e-commerce platform experience, analytical skills, and agile background to contribute to your digital initiatives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced e-commerce developer based in Karlsruhe with 5+ years of background in enterprise platforms. I have applied for the Product Owner role and would love to connect. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Product Owner - E-Commerce / Conversion / KPI (m/w/d) role at Workwise GmbH. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms and working in agile teams, I bring strong analytical and technical capabilities.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit. I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and am available starting 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
